summary: Cross-team onboarding provisioning gap review and time-bound access for incoming contractor
description: Issue summary: HR scheduled a data engineering contractor to start 2026-03-15 but multiple provisioning gaps were identified in the pre-start checklist. Impact: Contractor may not have access to required repos, GCP projects, Dedicated cluster service accounts, or laptop by start date which will delay ramp. Background: HR created an offer and Okta account on 2026-03-09. Automated SCIM group mapping did not place the user into the 'redwood-engineering:contractors' group. As a result the contractor is missing: 1) GitHub org team membership, 2) GCP project IAM roles via group binding, 3) VPN access (Okta group based policy), 4) loaner laptop shipping trigger. Request: run a small cross-team remediation and confirm time-bound access pattern that satisfies security (automatic expiry) and HR timing. Desired outcome: Contractor has ephemeral service-account(s) and Okta group membership with expiry set to 2026-06-15, laptop shipped with MDM enrolled, and a follow-up ticket to automate SCIM mapping rule fix.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) HR creates candidate record and triggers SCIM provisioning via Okta (observed 2026-03-09). 2) Verify Okta user exists but groups are empty. 3) Check SCIM integration logs in identity-provisioner: missing mapping rule for 'employment_type:contractor'. 4) GitHub org membership and GCP IAM bindings are group-driven so the user is not granted access. 5) Loaner laptop workflow relies on group tag 'needs-laptop' which did not attach, so no ship request was created.
investigation_notes: - Confirmed Okta user present: okta id 00u1abcd2Xy. - SCIM mapping rule 'employment_type==permanent -> redwood-engineering' exists but there is no rule for contractor. - identity-provisioner logs (2026-03-09 18:14 UTC) show 'skipping group mapping: key not found'. - GitOps repo 'infra/okta-scim-mappings' has an open PR (GH#2345) that adds a contractor mapping but it is pending review. - No existing loaner-ship event found for the user in asset-tracker. - Security requires KMS-wrapped key for any long-lived service account; proposed service account will be time-limited and monitored. - Quick mitigation: create a temporary group and manually add user, create time-bound service account with 'expiration' label and notify SRE for audit hook.
comments: 2026-03-10 | Maya Patel: Noticed contractor start date is Monday (2026-03-15). Raised because SCIM didn't place them into expected groups. Need quick manual remediation and then a permanent mapping fix.

2026-03-10 | Ethan Lowe: I can create a temporary Okta group and add the user; will create a time-limited service account for GCP and set expiration. Requesting the contractor's full name and public SSH key for laptop imaging and GitHub access.

2026-03-11 | Priya Singh (Security): Any service account must follow KMS envelope policy. If it's >24h we need approval. Prefer time-limited with automated rotation. Also confirm access review cadence.
2026-03-11 | HR Partner - Jonas Reed: Contractor name is Ava Moreno; SSH key provided in secure HR ticket. Start date confirmed 2026-03-15. Loaner laptop preference: MacBook Air. Please expedite.

2026-03-12 | Ethan Lowe: Temporary group created 'tmp-contractors-mar-2026', user added. Created service account 'svc-contractor-ava-20260315' with IAM roles: viewer on dev project, dedicated-cluster-borrower limited role. Set expiry tag 2026-06-15. Laptop order placed with MDM enrollment note. Pending Security approval for KMS wrapping.
2026-03-12 | Priya Singh (Security): Approved KMS-wrapping for the time-limited SA as long as audit logging is enabled and key access is scoped to infra-admins. Please attach audit link when done.

2026-03-12 | Maya Patel: Thanks. HR will follow up with contractor about laptop arrival ETA and onboarding schedule. Please create a follow-up ticket to automate SCIM mapping for 'employment_type:contractor'.
resolution_notes: Temporary Okta group created and user added, time-bound GCP service account created and tagged for expiry, laptop order placed with MDM enrollment instructions. Open actions: merge GH PR #2345 to add SCIM mapping rule for contractor, add automated 'needs-laptop' tag trigger to asset-tracker, and add audit link to this ticket once KMS wrap is confirmed. Follow-up automation ticket suggested.
next_steps: 1) Merge PR https://github.com/redwood-infra/infra/pull/2345 and monitor next SCIM sync (scheduled nightly). 2) Create automation ticket INT-912469 to add 'employment_type:contractor' mapping and 'needs-laptop' tag trigger. 3) SRE to attach KMS audit log link and close when audit validated. 4) HR to confirm laptop delivery to contractor.
